purpose: Teach: にもかかわらず/おっしゃら/あげれ/仰っ/当てはめ/まとまら/違わ/無き

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、悪天候にもかかわらず捜索を続けます
lines.en: We'll continue the search despite the bad weather.
lines.style: Official announcement cadence. Level, measured delivery — not cold, but structured. Slight weight on the commitment. Eye contact steady. The tone of someone speaking on record.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者がおっしゃらない事実、警察追及中ですね
lines.en: Yes. The facts the suspect won't disclose — the police are pursuing those right now.
lines.style: Attentive acknowledgment. Slightly formal register — matching Takeda's tone. A beat of careful listening before responding. Measured, respectful. No performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域支援にもっと予算をあげればと考えます
lines.en: We're thinking we need to allocate more budget to community support.
lines.style: Reflective, professional. Not presenting a demand, but a conclusion. Pause before the final clause — weight on the reasoning. Calm, thoughtful delivery. Voice settles slightly lower.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長官が仰ったご方針、警察、徹底ですね
lines.en: Yes. The policy the chief outlined — the police are applying it thoroughly.
lines.style: Confirming with respect. Slight nod in the voice on the opening. Even pacing, attentive. Not obsequious, but genuinely tracking. The tone of someone aligned with the direction.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、過去事例を当てはめて分析しております
lines.en: We're analyzing this case by applying patterns from previous similar cases.
lines.style: Methodical, composed. Suggests careful deliberation without being slow. Clinical precision but not distant. The voice of someone walking through a practiced process with integrity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証言がまとまらない事件、警察、慎重ですね
lines.en: Yes. In cases where witness testimony doesn't align — the police proceed with caution.
lines.style: Tracking carefully. Slight emphasis on the constraint — not a complaint, an acknowledgment of protocol. Steady, responsible. The voice of someone who understands the weight of inconsistency.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民の証言は調書と違わないようまとめます
lines.en: We'll compile the citizens' statements to ensure they align with the official record.
lines.style: Procedural but not rigid. Slight emphasis on the alignment — the intent is precision, not suppression. Clear delivery. Professional distance, measured commitment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者無きの事件は警察、未解決のままですね
lines.en: Yes. Cases without a suspect — those tend to remain unresolved.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment of a hard truth. Slight weight on the finality. Not resigned, but realistic. Soft close — the voice of someone familiar with the limits of what police work can answer.
